# uptrace_slack_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace Slack notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

resource "uptrace_slack_channel" "webhook" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-slack-webhook"
  priorities = ["high", "medium"]

  auth_method = "webhook"
  webhook_url = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/XXXX"
}

resource "uptrace_slack_channel" "bot" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-slack-bot"
  priorities = ["high"]

  auth_method = "token"
  token       = "xoxb-your-bot-token"
  channel     = "#alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method: webhook or token.
- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Slack channel or user (required when auth_method is token).
- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Slack bot token (required when auth_method is token).
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Slack webhook URL (required when auth_method is webhook).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_slack_channel.webhook 1:42
```
